visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair stands in a sunny park environment, looking distressed and clutching her clumpy-looking hair. A man dressed in a white chef uniform and wearing a stylized white mask holds a large silver ladle dripping oil directly over her head. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, casting clear shadows on the green grass background. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a silver ladle pouring a stream of clear yellow oil into a white frying pan on a kitchen stove. A person's hand in a white sleeve is holding the handle. (3) Back in the park, the woman is seen sitting on a yellow seesaw, looking dejected and touching her scalp. The camera uses a medium shot to capture her posture. (4) A man on a bright orange and white Ubike bicycle stops next to the woman. He wears the same white mask. He is seen applying a liquid from a small bottle to the bicycle chain, then jokingly moves to apply it to the woman's hair, causing her to react with shock. (5) The woman is now kneeling on the grass, looking extremely greasy and upset, with her arms spread wide. A hand reaches out to pull her up, and she transitions into a bright studio setting. (6) In a bathroom/studio setting, the woman happily massages thick white soap foam into her hair while looking at the camera. The lighting is soft and bright indoor lighting. (7) Product display shots follow, showing brown EDNA shampoo and serum bottles. The woman holds the bottles and demonstrates the serum texture on her hands. (8) Before-and-after graphics show the change from clumpy, greasy hair to smooth, voluminous hair. The woman talks directly to the camera with high energy, gesturing with her hands.
